summary: Multi-endpoint: thread base_url through call_llm (today it reads process-global LLAMACPP_BASE_URL) and round-robin across servers, so a second 4B on the 4070 adds throughput instead of contending; needs 5955d038

resolution.note: base_url threaded through llm.call_llamacpp/call_llm as a real parameter (env default preserved, forwarded only when set — no thread-local/env hack). tag_concepts.py gets repeatable --endpoint URL; chunks are split round-robin by list position into per-endpoint buckets, each with its own ThreadPoolExecutor sized to --parallel, so --parallel is PER ENDPOINT (documented in --help and _run_parallel_pool's docstring) — total concurrency = parallel * len(endpoints). No --endpoint => endpoints=[None] => byte-identical to pre-multi-endpoint behavior. Model guard now judges parallel*n_endpoints (total concurrency) so it can't be dodged by spreading a disallowed model across many 1-worker endpoints; slot pre-flight runs once per endpoint against that endpoint's own base_url. Single-writer invariant unchanged: only the main thread ever touches conn. 13 new tests in test_tag_concepts_multi_endpoint.py, all socket-free.
